payload.title: C047 — Adapt components: whiteboard-ink, wordmark-tiles, x-follow-card, yt-camera-move, yt-circle-pointer
payload.description:
## Dispatch packet C047: components
Binding decisions: initiative videoml-dbc2b1 D02–D05,D14,D15. Upstream commit 28181602fe2d9ffa38474a6e8155a89909a7b8aa.

## Exact upstream entries (complete all, no additions)
- registry/components/whiteboard-ink
- registry/components/wordmark-tiles
- registry/components/x-follow-card
- registry/components/yt-camera-move
- registry/components/yt-circle-pointer

## Owner and outputs
VideoML/stdlib owns implementations and catalog records. Reuse player/toolchain EffectInstance. Update videoml-org only through manifest consumption; no duplicate effect code. Upstream source is read-only.

## Procedure
For each listed entry: read its registry-item/source and dependencies; use the P05 mapping if its effect was already delivered by P06/P08/P09/P10, verify and link rather than duplicate. Otherwise adapt the source to D02 using its existing animation framework. Remove Hyperframes global timeline/runtime coupling via the VideoML adapter. Bundle neutral licensed fixture assets and preserve source notices. For interactive/network examples, record a deterministic scripted timeline and local fixture assets; no live API dependencies in capture. Expose meaningful source parameters as validated metadata, document dimensions/duration/seed/framework. Produce source example and poster/video preview. Run sequential/reverse/random/boundary captures and two-worker partition checks. Mark verified only after primary review.

## Acceptance
Every listed item has an inventory mapping, actual reusable implementation or verified shared alias, runnable fixture, parameter schema, local dependencies, licensing/provenance, and D14 evidence. Review screenshots against upstream's intended visual behavior, not just nonempty pixels. Do not claim broader catalog completion. Unknown asset license => neutral replacement; unresolvable functionality => return to primary for a recorded decision, not a silent omission.

## Handoff
Return a per-entry table of paths, verification commands, capture artifacts and remaining failures. No publishing or issue closure by worker. Process at most one such packet per worker; no two workers edit shared registry files concurrently.
